newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: One-month Saudi treasury bill rate up, rest flat.
newsitem.headline: One-month Saudi treasury bill rate up, rest flat.

text.p: The yield on one-month Saudi treasury bills was higher, but yields on three- and six-month paper were unchanged at this week's Saudi Arabian Monetary Agency offering worth three billion riyals, a banker said.
The yield on 28-day bills rose to 5.3965 percent from 5.3332 percent last week, while the rates on 91-day and 182-day bills were steady at 5.4360 percent and 5.4791 percent respectively.
One-month interbank rates were 5-1/2, 3/8 percent, three months were 5-9/16, 7/16 percent and six months were 5-5/8, 1/2 percent.
